title: Equilibrium Selection and Closure in DSGE Solution Methods
abstract: arXiv:2601.19329v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Standard DSGE solution practice closes forward-looking equilibrium problems by combining model specification with criteria that select one operational equilibrium from multiple candidate paths, yet this closure step typically remains implicit. This paper formalizes that closure step as a substantive operation in standard DSGE solution practice. By separating the economic specification ($S$), the self-referential operator ($T$), and the equilibrium selection rule ($\Pi$), the $(S, T, \Pi)$ triad provides a descriptive semantic grammar for comparing closure choices across familiar solution environments. The framework clarifies what standard solver diagnostics actually report, captures the regime-iteration logic of piecewise-linear methods like OccBin, explains why independent linear solvers often reproduce the same selected equilibrium, and distinguishes within-model refinements from specification-augmenting closure changes under indet

translated_title: DSGE求解方法中的均衡选择与封闭
translated_abstract: 标准的DSGE求解实践通过将模型设定与从多条候选路径中选择一个可操作均衡的准则相结合，来封闭前向预期均衡问题，然而这一封闭步骤通常保持隐式状态。本文将该封闭步骤形式化为标准DSGE求解实践中的一项实质性操作。通过分离经济设定（$S$）、自指算子（$T$）和均衡选择规则（$\Pi$），$(S, T, \Pi)$三元组为比较熟悉求解环境中的不同封闭选择提供了描述性的语义语法。该框架阐明了标准求解器诊断所实际报告的内容，刻画了诸如OccBin等分段线性方法的区制迭代逻辑，解释了为何独立的线性求解器通常能复现相同的所选均衡，并在不确定性下区分了模型内部的精细化改进与增强设定的封闭性变化。
tldr: 本文提出(S, T, Π)三元组框架，将DSGE求解中通常隐式的均衡封闭步骤形式化为实质性操作，为比较不同求解环境下的封闭选择提供了统一的语义语法。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the typically implicit equilibrium closure step in DSGE solution practice through an (S, T, Π) triad framework, providing a descriptive semantic grammar for comparing closure choices across solution environments.
